title: trachyspermum involucratum
intro: Trachyspermum involucratum, commonly known as Ajwain, is a plant species native to the Middle East and India, belonging to the Apiaceae family. It is valued for its carminative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, providing various health benefits, such as relief from digestive issues, respiratory problems, and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Ajwain include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce flatulence, and alleviate pain, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ajwain include compounds like thymol, limonene, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
